title: Non-stop supervision loop: a watchdog that every 20 minutes regenerates the taskboard, runs team.py check, and acts on what it finds (nudge an idle seat whose stream has claimable work, flag a stale claim for takeover, escalate a handoff that has waited too long for a verifier, and draft a new card when a stream runs dry). It must never auto-verify, auto-accept or commit; every action is logged and lands in the agents inboxes. Output scripts/team_watchdog.py + tests/unit/test_team_watchdog.py
